valuable_references.name: Blender Assembly Pitfalls
valuable_references.capability: Making Blender parts connect at the right size, direction and joint overlap
valuable_references.benefit: Catch silent 3D assembly mistakes before they break renders, exports or 3D prints.
valuable_references.distinct_method: Write a part-to-part connection map before modeling, then verify real world-space bounds, object axes, overlap and export scale against numeric tolerances.
valuable_references.reason_not_unchanged: Its example verification script clears every object in the current Blender scene. Running it in a live user scene could destroy work; a normals/volume check also reports about half the true geometric volume. Its claimed Blender measurements were not reproduced here.

valuable_references.capability: Checking government service forms and interfaces for accessibility
valuable_references.benefit: Catch keyboard, screen-reader, form-error and contrast barriers while an interface is being built, rather than after launch.

valuable_references.name: NetworkPolicy Debug

valuable_references.benefit: Find why pods cannot talk to each other without guessing, deleting or weakening live security rules.

promotion_rationale: Each of eleven has a specifically differentiated transferable method, concrete user benefit and a disclosed safety and license boundary; the four creative methods were individually graded and selected by their distinctive method, NOT automatically promoted from REFERENCE-ONLY flags. limitations: This is a curated subset: zero in this starter shelf is not a claim of zero valuable skills in any other domain.
None of the three has an executed security scan, behavioral acceptance or unchanged-use license/safety clearance from skillz.
The referenced sources carry their own license obligations; skillz retains links and independent summaries, not their instructions or code.
Packaged scripts, CLI/tools and content remain untrusted until host-specific rights, safety and action authorization are established.
The 28-record Siclaw root-license scope metadata was corrected from MIT to Apache-2.0 after reading its pinned LICENSE. Existing grades, SHA identities, and candidate decisions are unchanged.

Four new Q6 methods have exact source/pin/SKILL.md fingerprints and 10-axis static scores, but full upstream package-tree identities and exhaustive per-file rights remain UNKNOWN; do not treat them as unchanged-use eligible or globally deduplicated.
